name: fl-playlist-focus
description: Sub-recipe: give FL Studio's playlist the keyboard focus and move the playhead to the song start.
notes: The click at (1400,168) lands on the playlist ruler: it is what puts the keyboard focus in the playlist pane, without which home/PgUp/Enter go nowhere (measured: a background key with no click changed 14 px, the same key after this click changed 190341 px).
Both steps are foreground: FL drops background key events silently.
Proof: the transport clock (native x 900-1060, y 6-40) reads 0:00:00 after this sub-recipe. FL exposes no accessibility tree, so the check is a screenshot the caller takes.
Coordinate (1400,168) is a screenshot coordinate of the loaded layout, not an element: re-measure it if the window is rearranged.
